parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State at least one correct derivative, $-2\sin(\frac12x)$ or $1/(4-x)^2$ [B1]. Equate the product of the derivatives to $-1$, or equivalent [M1]. Obtain a correct equation, e.g. $2\sin(\frac12x)=1/(4-x)^2$ [A1]. Rearrange correctly to the given result $a=4-\sqrt{2\sin(\frac12a)}$ [A1]. Total 4.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Calculate values of a relevant expression or pair of expressions at $a=2$ and $a=3$ [M1]. Printed verification: at $a=2$, $2<2.7027\ldots$; at $a=3$, $3>2.587\ldots$. The two other printed acceptable pairs are $(0.703,-0.412)$ and $(2.317,-0.995)$, with the first entry evaluated at $a=2$ and the second at $a=3$. Values must be correct to at least 2 d.p. Complete the argument correctly with correct calculated values [A1]. Total 2.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use $a_{n+1}=4-\sqrt{2\sin(\frac12a_n)}$ correctly at least once [M1]. Obtain $2.611$ [A1]. Show sufficient iterations to 5 d.p. to justify $2.611$ to 3 d.p., or show a sign change in $(2.6105,2.6115)$ [A1]. Printed acceptable sequences include $2,2.70272,2.60285,2.61152,2.61070,2.61077$; truncation or more than 5 d.p. is condoned. Total 3.
